recipe.visualDefinition: A macro photograph of a weathered, coarse stone surface featuring a deeply engraved abstract symbol resembling a stylized 'G' or 'T'. The composition is framed by two bands of text: a bold, red display title at the top and a smaller, gold serif subtitle at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Textural contrast between the rough stone and the clean graphic typography
Color contrast between the earthy brown/grey stone and the vibrant red text
Depth relationship between the surface of the rock and the recessed carving
coreInvariants: Central engraved symbol in the stone
Horizontal split composition with text at extreme top and bottom
Strong directional lighting creating deep shadows in the rock crevices

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The engraved symbol is centrally located, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The deep, dark shadow within the engraved symbol acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold red text at the top, moves down to the central carving, and rests on the smaller text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The expansive, textured rock surface serves as functional negative space, providing a rugged background for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns, greys, and tans of the natural stone surface.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows within the rock texture and carving.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red for the main title and muted gold for the subtitle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the stone texture; high saturation in the top text against a low-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses wide, blocky geometric forms with uniform stroke weight.
Bottom text uses a high-contrast serif with delicate terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text features a slight drop shadow to separate it from the busy stone background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a modern, bold sans-serif and a traditional, elegant serif.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text
Lowercase styling of the bottom text
avoid: Using the same font for both roles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, blocky feel of the top text.
Matches the elegant, high-contrast serif feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution macro photo of a rough, weathered brown stone wall. In the center, there should be a deep, primitive-style carving of an abstract hook-like symbol. Use harsh side-lighting to emphasize the texture and create deep shadows in the carving.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the main title in a wide, bold red sans-serif at the very top, centered, with a subtle black drop shadow. Place the subtitle in a small, gold serif font at the very bottom, centered, using all lowercase letters.

verificationChecks: Is the stone texture tactile and detailed?
Is the red text clearly legible against the stone?
Is the central symbol recessed into the rock rather than printed on top?
Are the two text elements placed at the extreme vertical edges?

avoid: Centered text in the middle of the image

postGenerationChecks: Verify the carving looks physically engraved into the surface.
Check that the red text has a subtle drop shadow for legibility.
Ensure the bottom text is significantly smaller than the top text.
Confirm the lighting direction is consistent across the stone and the carving.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro stone photography + central primitive engraving + dual-edge contrasting typography.
